results.title: TotalEnergies teams with Petronas, Sonangol, OIL on methane - World Oil
results.snippet: # TotalEnergies teams with Petronas, Sonangol, OIL on methane. (WO) – **TotalEnergies** has announced new and expanded agreements with three national oil companies, **Petronas** in Malaysia, **Sonangol** in Angola and **Oil India Ltd. (OIL)**, to cut methane emissions. The company highlighted the partnerships at a meeting of Oil and Gas Decarbonization Charter (OGDC) member companies in Abu Dhabi.
